summary: Full backend + frontend testing for QuickBuck marketing site. All 8 backend pytest tests passed (waitlist CRUD/idempotency/validation, contact validation, count endpoint). All critical frontend flows work: hero waitlist submit, contact form submit, navigation across 6 pages, 404 page, mobile menu open/close, waitlist count display from API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: WaitlistEntry stores created_at as ISO string while StatusCheck stores datetime then serializes — inconsistent style but functional.
Waitlist count display = count + 2847 always (so display starts at 2847, not strictly > 2847 when 0). Spec says >= 2847 which is met. Consider documenting this seed value.
Pydantic EmailStr requires email-validator. Verify present in requirements.txt (it is, since tests pass).
No rate limiting on POST /api/waitlist or /api/contact — possible spam vector for marketing site, consider adding throttling.
Toasts render twice in DOM (sonner duplicates) — cosmetic, not blocking.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created several test waitlist entries and contact entries with TEST_/test_ prefixes during testing (not cleaned up; harmless for marketing DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://instant-earnings-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in <1s. Frontend uses data-testid selectors matching the spec. Sonner toast library renders toasts twice in DOM (likely portal duplication) — be aware when asserting toast text.
